newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Ericsson 9 mo profit 29 pct up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Ericsson 9 mo profit 29 pct up.

text.p: Swedish telecoms company LM. Ericsson was expected to post a pre-tax profit of 6.24 billion crowns for the first nine months of 1996, a Reuter poll of 15 analysts found on Friday.
This would be a 29 percent rise over the corresponding period a year ago when the company posted a 4.81 billion crown profit.
Forecasts varied between 5.88 and 6.64 billion crown with the average 6.24 billion crowns.
Sales were expected to be 78.24 billion crowns, an increase from 66.90 billion a year earlier.
For the calendar year 1996 analysts on average forecast a profit of 9.68 billion crowns compared to 7.62 billion in 1995.
The average forecast for 1996 was 240 million crowns higher than during a Reuter poll ahead of the half year report.
For 1997 a poll of 13 analysts forecast a pre-tax profit of 11.79 billion crowns which means the average forecast is marginally higher than the previous forecast of 11.66 billion crowns.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Carnegie, CSFB, Enskilda, Fiba, Foreningsbanken, Handelsbanken, Kleinwort Benson, Matteus, Merrill Lynch, Morgan Grenfell, Morgan Stanley, Nordiska, Penser, Swedbank, and Unibank.
Ericsson is due to release its nine month results on October 29.
